title: SINT-Flow: Schema Integration using Large Language Model Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2607.24492v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The goal of schema integration is, given a set of input schemata or tables, to derive a global, unified schema that is able to represent the concepts, attributes, and relationships of all input tables in a coherent fashion. This paper presents SINT-Flow, a schema integration framework composed of five LLM-based operators that can be combined into workflows to perform fully automated, end-to-end schema integration. In contrast to existing approaches, SINT-Flow can process denormalized source tables that contain attributes describing multiple entity types. During the schema integration process, these tables are decomposed into separate entity-specific relations. To evaluate SINT-Flow, we introduce SINT-Bench, a schema integration benchmark comprising 10 schema integration tasks consisting of altogether 93 relational tables, including tables that describe multiple types of entities. translated_title: SINT-Flow：使用大语言模型工作流的模式集成
translated_abstract: 模式集成的目标是，给定一组输入的模式或表，推导出一个全局的、统一的模式，能够以连贯的方式表示所有输入表的概念、属性和关系。本文提出了SINT-Flow，这是一个由五个基于大语言模型（LLM）的算子组成的模式集成框架，这些算子可以组合成工作流，以执行完全自动化的端到端模式集成。与现有方法相比，SINT-Flow能够处理包含描述多种实体类型属性的反规范化源表。在模式集成过程中，这些表会被分解为独立的、特定于实体的关系。为了评估SINT-Flow，我们引入了SINT-Bench，这是一个模式集成基准，包含10个模式集成任务，共由93个关系表组成，其中包括描述多种实体类型的表。我们使用GPT-5.2以及开源（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出由五个LLM算子组成的模式集成框架SINT-Flow，可实现全自动端到端模式集成，并首次支持将含多种实体类型的反规范化源表分解为实体特定的关系，同时发布了包含10个任务、93张关系表的模式集成基准SINT-Bench。
en_tdlr: SINT-Flow is an LLM-workflow-based framework for fully automated end-to-end schema integration that, unlike prior approaches, can decompose denormalized source tables describing multiple entity types, evaluated on the newly introduced SINT-Bench benchmark of 10 tasks with 93 relational tables.
